quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?

options.text: Make left turns.
Make U-turns.
Pass slow-moving traffic.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make left turns.
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:

options.text: Loss of hearing.
Pollution.
Carbon monoxide poisoning.
Poor engine performance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes dangerous fumes from your car. A leak lets these fumes enter the cabin. Fix any leaks right away to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.
The road is slippery when wet.
The road curves ahead.
You are approaching a hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery in wet conditions.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, you should usually:

options.text: Go slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic around you.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up to freeway traffic speed. This helps you blend in safely. You must yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after coming to a complete stop.
Right turns are not allowed.
Left turns are allowed.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: This is a law sign that you must obey. No right turns are allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Winding road.
Pedestrian crossing.
Low ground railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The bottom of your vehicle may drag or get stuck on the tracks where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection, you should:

options.text: Treat it like a caution sign and continue through.
Stop immediately.
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a yellow light, try to stop before the intersection if it is safe. If you are too close to stop safely, drive carefully through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: T intersection.
Lane shifting.
Side road.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: T intersection.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead. Get ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: When driving on wet roads, remember:

options.text: The pavement is extra slippery right after it starts to rain.
Wet roads can cause hydroplaning.
Give yourself more space to stop.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are very slippery, especially right after it starts to rain. Your tires can lose grip and hydroplane. Slow down and give yourself extra distance to stop.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Cannot exit the freeway.
Can either continue through or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane leads to an exit ramp. You must change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you will be forced to exit.

questions.question: A car is coming toward you with bright headlights. What should you do?

options.text: Use your bright lights until the other driver dims theirs.
Flash your lights on and off to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and speed up to pass quickly.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look away from the bright headlights and toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded until the car passes.

questions.question: What can help reduce road rage and aggressive driving?

options.text: Allow extra travel time.
Obey posted speed limits.
Use proper turn signals.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, use turn signals, obey speed limits, and allow plenty of time for your trip.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, what should you do?

options.text: Always insist on the right-of-way over a vehicle when using a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching.
Enter a crosswalk at any time because the driver must stop.
Use crosswalks only if they are convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are near. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a close vehicle may not have time to stop.

questions.question: What does a red and white triangular sign mean at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross.
Always come to a full stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: This is a yield sign. Decrease your speed and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Be ready to stop if necessary.

questions.question: What affects how much space you need to cross traffic?

options.text: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.
The presence of a stop sign.
Your use of turn signals.
Cars behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather conditions, and oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: The space you need depends on road conditions, weather, and how fast traffic is coming toward you.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: You may use this lane.
No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You have the right-of-way.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may use this lane.
questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, what must you do?

options.text: Drive slowly to let approaching vehicles and pedestrians move out of your way.
Honk your horn so traffic and pedestrians know you are coming.
Stop and only go when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
Ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and only go when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the street from a driveway. Wait for all approaching vehicles and crossing pedestrians to pass. Failing to stop is illegal.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalks, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the lightest traffic.
On the same side traffic is moving.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road that faces the traffic nearest you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
Work crew ahead.
Side road.
Playground ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should slow down.

questions.question: When is driving below the speed limit illegal?

options.text: When slow driving disrupts the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.
When driving in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: When slow driving disrupts the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you disrupt normal traffic flow. You can be cited for driving too slowly.

questions.question: When can you drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road?

options.text: If you are not driving.
If you are in the back seat.
If you are in the back of a pickup truck.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or have open alcohol in a vehicle on a public road. This includes the driver and passenger areas.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a curve or hill because other vehicles are unlikely to be coming.
By driving on the shoulder of the road.
If there is a solid yellow line on your side and the passing lane is clear.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: None of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not pass on hills or curves because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the shoulder. Never pass by crossing a solid yellow line.

questions.question: What best keeps you and others safe when backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you sit in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors.
Turn up the radio to get the attention of people nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you sit in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Backing is risky because drivers cannot see everything behind the vehicle. Always walk to the back first to check for children and small objects.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right. Slow down to the speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for drunk drivers.
Curves ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.
Brake quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
School crossing ahead.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on green that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Keep right.
No U-turn.
The left lane must turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Drive slowly and carefully.
Do not use your high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to see the road better.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Fog makes it hard to see other vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signals. Drive slowly and carefully. Use low beams instead of high beams in fog.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Curves ahead.
A divided highway starts.
The divided highway ends.
Bumpy road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What is distracted driving?

options.text: Very uncommon.
Extremely dangerous.
Not a concern.
Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Extremely dangerous.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is very dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Staying focused on driving helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: Which recommendation does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Keep your windshield clean.
Know that tinted windows make it harder to see in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking into oncoming headlights makes your pupils shrink. When the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see the road clearly.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without stopping completely.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and vehicles crossing the intersection. Wait until it is clear before you go.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs about upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on white background
Black letters or symbols on yellow background
White letters or symbols on blue background
White letters or symbols on green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs about hazards ahead are yellow with black letters or symbols. Construction zone warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: Highway signs that require drivers to follow an order are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must do. Breaking this rule can result in a penalty.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Railroad crossing.
One-way traffic.
Limited parking.
Playground ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: Circular signs show railroad crossings ahead. This sign warns you to look for trains.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No right turns.
Right turns are permitted.
Stop before turning right.
Sharp curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means an action is forbidden. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Drive through if there is no other traffic.
Keep going because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights mark dangerous intersections. Treat them the same as stop signs.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians ahead.
End of construction zone.
School crossing ahead.
Flagger ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Flagger ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is controlling traffic in a construction zone ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: All traffic must turn.
Turn right at the intersection.
Parking area ahead.
Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming. Be ready for traffic.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: You can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
You can pass from the lane with the solid line.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means passing is allowed only from the side with the broken line.
